term.title: target measurement uncertainty
term.longtitle: IUPAC Gold Book - target measurement uncertainty

definitions.text: Measurement uncertainty specified as an upper limit and decided on the basis of the intended use of measurement results.

notes.1: Setting and using target uncertainty is described in.

sources: PAC, 2021, 93, 997. 'Metrological and quality concepts in analytical chemistry (IUPAC Recommendations 2021)' on page 1042 (https://doi.org/10.1515/pac-2019-0819)
